piecemeal
音标：英 /'piːsmiːl/  美 /'pismil/

n. 片；块

product

例句：In middle age, this Shakespeare has a fresh-faced complexion, a closely trimmed auburn beard, a long straight nose and a full, almost bouffant hairstyle.
